Messages.Author: Darkelf
Messages.Body:
1.- ¿Can you play a discipline card on an uncontrolled vampire? I have
allways thought that you can, but I have been said that you can´t. Actually,
the card doesn´t state any controlled or ready state of the vampire.

2.- Will there be any big changes in the basic rules of the game in the
Sabbat War rules? I have heard something about it but I don´t know if
they´re just rumors or what.

3.- What can we do here in Madrid, Spain to make the distributor to give
away the Lucitas that they have boxed in their warehouse? Don´t they know
that those are free and promotional stuff to give away to players for them
to enjoy and wait anxiously to the forecoming sabbat War expansion? They
keep telling us that they will give them away in the official Sabbat War
Tournament that will take place in November. And I say, by then, the
"promotional" and "preview" characteristic of the card would be gone, we
would have been able to buy as many boxes as we want of Sabbat War by then
(if you guys at USA don´t buy them all ;). Well, I just don´t understand it,
all of you in this newsgroup saying: Hey!!!, Lucitas for everyone on the
Tournament!!! Yihaaaa. What I say around here is, please, help!!!!!!

Thanks in advance

Darkelf

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Darkelf wrote:
>
> 1.- ¿Can you play a discipline card on an uncontrolled vampire? I have
> allways thought that you can, but I have been said that you can´t. Actually,
> the card doesn´t state any controlled or ready state of the vampire.

No. Only cards in play can be affected by default. Cards out of play (in
the Crypt or Uncontrolled Region, for example) can be affected only if
explicitly declared on card text.

> 2.- Will there be any big changes in the basic rules of the game in the
> Sabbat War rules? I have heard something about it but I don´t know if
> they´re just rumors or what.

They're certainly just rumors, since no official word has been given on
the subject. No big changes are expected.
